title: How Contaminated Is Your Benchmark? Measuring Dataset Leakage in Large Language Models with Kernel Divergence
authors_zh: Hyeong Kyu Choi, Maxim Khanov, Hongxin Wei, Yixuan Li
paper_type_zh: 审计、污染或验证器鲁棒性论文
best_for_zh: 需要复盘基准污染、评估偏差、验证器失效或奖励投机风险的研究者。
one_line: Kernel Divergence Score compares embedding-kernel structure before and after benchmark fine-tuning to quantify leakage.
以微调前后样本嵌入核矩阵的结构变化，量化候选基准的数据集级泄漏。
why: It exposes leakage as an empirical precondition of a benchmark result instead of assuming scores are uncontaminated.
inclusion_reason: Measures benchmark leakage with a controlled, monotone dataset-level contamination audit.

title: Problem
问题
html: Benchmark scores can be inflated when a model has seen test data during pretraining, but conventional membership signals are noisy at dataset scale. The paper asks for a contamination score that changes monotonically with controlled overlap and is stable across sampled benchmark subsets.
若模型在预训练中见过测试数据，基准分数会虚高；但常见成员推断信号在数据集层面噪声很大。论文寻找一种污染分数：它应随受控重叠比例单调变化，并在不同抽样的基准子集上保持稳定。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Kernel Divergence Score (KDS) compares an RBF kernel matrix over normalized sample embeddings before and after one epoch of LoRA fine-tuning on the candidate dataset. Unseen samples change more under fine-tuning, so the negative gated kernel divergence rises with the fraction already known to the model.
核散度分数（KDS）比较候选数据集样本归一化嵌入在 LoRA 微调一轮前后的 RBF 核矩阵。未见样本会因微调而改变更多，因此取带软门控的核散度相反数，可随模型已见样本比例升高而上升。

title: Method
方法
html: Embed all candidate samples, fine-tune the inspected model with LoRA for one epoch, then re-embed them. Form pairwise RBF kernels before and after tuning; weight each log-ratio by pre-tuning similarity and normalize by kernel mass. Negate the divergence so higher is more contaminated. The controlled study mixes seen and unseen WikiMIA, BookMIA, or ArxivTection samples at overlap ratios 0--1.
先嵌入候选样本，对被检模型做一轮 LoRA 微调后再次嵌入；计算微调前后的两两 RBF 核，以微调前相似度门控 log 比值并按核质量归一化。取散度的相反数，数值越高表示越可能污染。受控实验把 WikiMIA、BookMIA 或 ArxivTection 的已见与未见样本按 0--1 比例混合。

title: Evidence
证据
html: KDS obtains mean Spearman/Pearson 0.990/0.982 across WikiMIA, BookMIA and ArxivTection, versus 0.966/0.964 for perplexity; the three dataset pairs are 0.999/0.993, 0.997/0.979 and 0.975/0.974. Removing fine-tuning drops WikiMIA correlation to 0.683/0.749. On six Pile subsets it remains 0.944/0.948, and on Mistral, Llama-3.1-8B and Phi-3 it is 0.999/0.996, 0.982/0.952 and 0.892/0.890.
KDS 在 WikiMIA、BookMIA、ArxivTection 上平均 Spearman/Pearson 为 0.990/0.982，高于 perplexity 的 0.966/0.964；移除微调后 WikiMIA 降至 0.683/0.749。六个 Pile 子集仍为 0.944/0.948，说明受控重叠信号可跨数据集和模型复现，但不等于真实预训练来源证明。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Instead of scoring each sequence statically, KDS makes adaptation response the leakage signal and measures the global geometry of pairwise embeddings. The pre-tuning kernel acts as a soft gate, so the score is not merely a distance between two fine-tuning snapshots. It is a dataset-level ranking metric, not a sample-level proof of memorization.
KDS 不静态地给每条序列打分，而把模型适应候选数据后的变化作为泄漏信号，并度量样本对嵌入的整体几何结构。微调前的核充当软门控；但它只是数据集层面的排序分数，不是单样本记忆的证明。

title: Limitations
局限
html: KDS requires white-box embeddings and fine-tuning, and its pairwise kernel is quadratic in sample count. Its controlled labels establish sensitivity to overlap, not the actual provenance of a model's pretraining corpus. Results depend on model, layer, fine-tuning recipe and temporal/domain shift; the score cannot identify which source or individual item leaked.
KDS 需要白盒 embedding 和微调，其成对 kernel 的计算量随样本数呈平方增长。受控标签只能证明该分数对重叠敏感，并不能证明模型预训练语料的真实来源。结果依赖模型、层位、微调配方以及时间与领域漂移；该分数无法指认究竟是哪个来源或哪一条样本发生了泄漏。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use KDS as a white-box preflight check before comparing models on a benchmark: pin model revision, chosen layer, LoRA recipe, gamma and sampled items, then report the contamination curve rather than one threshold. Pair it with source-lineage and held-out temporal checks; a high score calls for caution, not automatic exclusion.
比较模型基准结果前，可把 KDS 作为白盒预检：固定模型版本、读出层、LoRA 方案、gamma 与抽样样本，并报告污染曲线而非单一阈值。还应配合数据来源追踪和时间留出检查；高分提示谨慎，不等于自动剔除。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The important ablation is adaptation: without fine-tuning the signal collapses. Gamma .001--1 is stable, gamma 10 weak, late layers strongest, and one epoch SGD best. Preserve the five independently sampled subsets and do not read the controlled seen/unseen construction as an estimate of real-web contamination prevalence.

1. 关键消融是适配：不做微调，信号就会崩塌。
  2. gamma 在 .001–1 之间稳定，取 10 时明显偏弱；靠后的层信号最强，单轮 SGD 效果最好。
  3. 保留五个独立采样的子集，不要把受控的 seen/unseen 构造读成真实网络污染比例的估计。
